_readme.switches: true = show this ad / turn this on, false = hide it / turn it off. Every ad has its own switch.
_readme.ad_network: Which ad network serves the ads: admob | none (no ads anywhere).
_readme.ad_ids: AdMob ad unit ids (text). The iOS AdMob App ID itself is in the app (Info.plist GADApplicationIdentifier), not here.
_readme.app_open.on_launch / on_return: App-open ad on a fresh start / when coming back to the app from the background.
_readme.app_open.cooldown_seconds: Number. Minimum seconds between two app-open ads. 0 = no limit.
_readme.app_open.launch_wait_seconds: Number. On a fresh start, how many seconds the app-open ad may take to load. If it is slower, it is skipped instead of popping up later. Default 10.
_readme.native_ads.<page>: Native ad on that page: library, updates, history, browse (sources list), extensions, more, manga_details, source_browse (a source's manga grid), global_search.
_readme.reader.launch_ad: Ad when a chapter is opened. "mode": interstitial | rewarded | both (alternates) | off, plus optional every_n / cooldown_seconds.
_readme.interstitials.<spot>: Interstitial at: open_manga (tap on a manga), open_source (a source opens), global_search (search all sources opens), install_extension (after an extension installs), add_repository (after a repository is added), tab_switch (bottom tab change), more_menu (tap on an item in the More menu).
_readme.interstitials.cooldown_seconds: Number. Default minimum seconds between two full-screen ads (counted from when the previous ad closed). A spot's own cooldown_seconds overrides it. 0 = no limit.
_readme.interstitials.every_n: Number. Default every-N for spots without their own every_n, counted across all of them. 0 = every time.
_readme.remove_ads_reward.enabled / minutes: The green 'Remove ads' button (Library and More): watch a video, get this many minutes without pop-up ads.
_readme.review.min_opens_before_prompt: Number. App opens before the rate-us prompt (Apple's system prompt) can appear.
_readme.review.days_between_prompts: Number. Days to wait before asking for a rating again.
_readme.maintenance.title / message: Text shown on the maintenance screen when maintenance.enabled is true (the app is blocked).
_readme.update.title / message: Text shown on the update screen when update.enabled is true (the app is blocked).
_readme.update.app_store_url: Text. App Store link the Update button opens.
_readme.telegram.title / message: Text of the Telegram invite popup.
_readme.telegram.channel_url: Text. Link opened by the Join button, e.g. https://t.me/yourchannel.
_readme.telegram.min_opens_before_prompt: Number. App opens before the Telegram popup can appear.
_readme.telegram.days_between_prompts: Number. Days to wait before showing the Telegram popup again.
_readme.placements: Every ad spot is its own object: "enabled": true/false turns it on or off. Optional per spot: "every_n" (show only every Nth time, e.g. 3 = every 3rd tap), "cooldown_seconds" (overrides the global interstitial cooldown for this spot). Native spots also take "size": "compact" (one row) or "large" (big image/video).
_readme.reader.<spot>: next_chapter_interstitial (going to another chapter), exit_interstitial (leaving the reader), chapter_end_native (native on the 'Chapter finished' screen).
_readme.app_features.apk_import: true = show the 'Install .apk' buttons (Library and Extensions), false = hide them.
_readme.iap.enabled: true = Pro features are locked behind the in-app purchase. false = everything is free (no paywall). People who already bought Pro always keep it and never see ads.
_readme.iap.revenuecat_api_key: RevenueCat Apple public SDK key (appl_...). Empty = purchases off and Pro features stay locked.
_readme.iap.entitlement: RevenueCat entitlement id that means Pro (default pro).
_readme.iap.plans: Packages of the current RevenueCat offering to show, in order: lifetime, yearly (Annual package), monthly. Remove one to hide it. Prices come from App Store Connect.
_readme.iap.highlight: Plan pre-selected on the paywall with a 'Best value' tag: lifetime | yearly | monthly.
_readme.iap.pro_features.<feature>: true = this feature needs Pro, false = free for everyone. downloads (offline chapters), reader_paged (paged left-to-right / right-to-left reading), global_search (search all sources), local_import (.cbz/.zip/.epub import), library_tools (library sort options + bulk mark read/remove), backup (create / restore backups). Pro always removes all ads.
_readme.iap.terms_url / privacy_url: Links on the paywall (Apple requires both for subscriptions). Default terms = Apple's standard EULA.
